svg.title: Tram stop widths
svg.desc: Two 3.5 metre side platforms and a 5.5 metre track zone total 12.5 metres, before outer routes and buffers. Source claims: tram-width. Longitudinal extent 5 m is illustrative. Platforms use the general-context 0.30 m height above rail datum; Helsinki normally uses 0.27 m. Furniture and person placement do not validate circulation or passenger capacity.
